## [1.3.0](https://github.com/jzl1/morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-08)

### ✨ New Features

* **juicessh:** add Unlock Pro patch ([76a4098](https://github.com/jzl1/morphe-patches/commit/76a409864eeb8e72ab11cd6620388c39ec473736))
* **ltediscovery:** add Unlock Pro and opt-in Donate patches ([abb1a13](https://github.com/jzl1/morphe-patches/commit/abb1a136c810913c94f2b1a29432775373ec46f6))

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Forces Firebase analytics and crash reporting off, ignoring the in-app privacy toggles and their defaults.

patches.name: Hide sign-in banner
patches.description: Removes the orange "Sign in" prompt below the toolbar. The account screen stays reachable from the drawer.

patches.name: Neutralize tamper fork bomb
patches.description: Stops the native anti-tamper response that spawns unbounded threads and crashes the app a few seconds after launch on a repackaged build.

patches.name: Skip update attestation
patches.description: Stops the app updater from sending the client key and Android Keystore attestation chain to analiti.com during its version check. Other backend calls are unaffected.

patches.name: Unlock Expert
patches.description: Unlocks the Expert tier and disables the PairIP licence check.

patches.name: Bundle QuickTest configuration
patches.description: Adds the stock QTRUN-signed configuration.xml and skips the native config-integrity mismatch gate, so the app can start without a fresh /cgi/report response.

patches.name: Export AdvancedActivity (test only)
patches.description: Marks AdvancedActivity as exported for adb-based license-state verification. Disabled by default; not needed for normal use.

patches.name: Unlock Ultimate
patches.description: Unlocks all Ultimate features and makes the app usable on a clean install by bundling a signed config and bypassing the native config-integrity gate.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks JuiceSSH Pro features without a Play purchase by forcing the client-side entitlement and signature checks. Online features (CloudSync, TeamShare, EC2 Link, plugin repository, purchase/restore) will not work because api.sonelli.com is offline.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pro and Pro Plus features by forcing the two client-side BillingEntitlements predicates to true. Also disables Google PairIP App Licensing so the repackaged build can start.

patches.name: Unlock Pro Plus / Donate
patches.description: Marks the Pro Plus / Donate (e6) tier as owned. It does not add any feature beyond Pro Plus - the only visible effect is the 'Pro Plus / Donate' label and the supporter badge. Requires Unlock Pro.
